successCriteria.description: AuditRecord entity interface exists at `src/modules/audit/audit.model.ts` with exact fields: id (string), entityType (string), entityId (string), action (AuditAction), oldValues (Record<string, unknown> | null), newValues (Record<string, unknown> | null), performedBy (string), performedAt (Date), ipAddress (string | null), userAgent (string | null), createdAt (Date). Imports AuditAction from `shared/types/audit-action.enum`.

IAuditRepository interface extends IBaseRepository<AuditRecord> and declares findByEntity(entityType: string, entityId: string), findByPerformedBy(performedBy: string), and findByDateRange(startDate: Date, endDate: Date). AuditRepository class extends BaseRepository<AuditRecord>, table name 'audit_logs', and implements all three custom methods plus inherited CRUD.

IAuditService interface declares log(entry: Omit<AuditRecord, 'id' | 'createdAt'>): Promise<AuditRecord>, getAuditTrail(entityType: string, entityId: string): Promise<AuditRecord[]>, and getByEntity(entityType: string, entityId: string): Promise<AuditRecord[]>. AuditService implementation delegates to IAuditRepository: log calls repository.create, getAuditTrail and getByEntity both call repository.findByEntity.

Notification entity interface exists at `src/modules/notification/notification.model.ts` with exact fields: id (string), recipientId (string), type (NotificationType), title (string), message (string), relatedEntityType (string | null), relatedEntityId (string | null), status ('UNREAD' | 'READ'), createdAt (Date), readAt (Date | null). Imports NotificationType from `shared/types/notification-type.enum`.

INotificationRepository interface extends IBaseRepository<Notification> and declares findByRecipient(recipientId: string), findUnreadByRecipient(recipientId: string), and markAsRead(id: string). NotificationRepository class extends BaseRepository<Notification>, table name 'notifications'. markAsRead updates status to 'READ' and readAt to the current timestamp.

INotificationService interface declares send(notification: Omit<Notification, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'readAt'>): Promise<Notification>, getNotifications(recipientId: string): Promise<Notification[]>, markAsRead(id: string): Promise<Notification>, and markAllAsRead(recipientId: string): Promise<void>. NotificationService delegates to INotificationRepository. send creates with status 'UNREAD' and readAt null. markAllAsRead finds all unread via findUnreadByRecipient then calls markAsRead on each.

Both modules have barrel index.ts files re-exporting their model interface, repository interface + class, and service interface + class. Audit barrel at `src/modules/audit/index.ts`, notification barrel at `src/modules/notification/index.ts`.

constraints: All database access must go through the repository layer — no inline SQL in services. AuditRepository and NotificationRepository must extend BaseRepository and use the shared pg Pool from `src/shared/db/connection.ts`.
All imports from shared modules must use non-relative paths from baseUrl 'src' (e.g., `shared/types`, `shared/base-repository`, `shared/error-types`, `shared/db/connection`).
No DI container — services receive repository instances via constructor injection. The code agent chooses the constructor shape.
No `any` type — use `unknown` with type guards where needed (HARNESS.json constraint `no-any`).

Audit logs are append-only — the AuditRepository must not expose update or delete operations that mutate existing records. The inherited BaseRepository.update and delete are available but the service must never call them.
outOfScope: Routes, controllers, and HTTP wiring for audit and notification modules — these are deferred to a later phase (Sub-phase 5.2: App Wiring & Balance Routes).
Unit and integration tests for audit and notification modules — these are produced in Sub-phase 5.3: Integration Tests.
Integration of audit logging into LeaveRequestService (e.g., logging on approve/reject/cancel) — the audit module is built standalone; callers wire it in a later phase.

entityInvariants.invariant: AuditRecord is immutable after creation — once persisted, no field may be updated or deleted. The repository's update and delete methods are inherited from BaseRepository but must never be called on audit_logs rows.

Notification status transitions are one-way: UNREAD → READ only. Once READ, a notification must never revert to UNREAD. readAt is null when status is UNREAD and must be set to a Date when status transitions to READ.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth enforcement at this layer — the caller is responsible for providing the performedBy value. The service trusts the caller.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Must not throw on valid input. Repository-level errors (e.g., DB connection failure) propagate as-is.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth enforcement at this layer — the caller provides recipientId. The service trusts the caller.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Creates notification with status 'UNREAD' and readAt null. Must not throw on valid input.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth enforcement at this layer.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: If the notification is already READ, the operation is a no-op (idempotent). If the notification does not exist, throws NotFoundError.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth enforcement at this layer.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Finds all unread notifications for the recipient via findUnreadByRecipient, then calls markAsRead on each individually. If no unread notifications exist, completes silently (no-op).

consistencyRequirements.requirement: AuditRepository must extend BaseRepository<AuditRecord> following the same pattern as EmployeeRepository, LeavePolicyRepository, LeaveBalanceRepository, and LeaveRequestRepository — overriding tableName, using the shared pool, and accepting optional PoolClient on all custom methods.
NotificationRepository must extend BaseRepository<Notification> following the same pattern — tableName override, shared pool, optional PoolClient on custom methods.

AuditService and NotificationService must follow the same constructor-injection pattern as EmployeeService, LeavePolicyService, LeaveBalanceService, and LeaveRequestService — receiving their repository interface as a constructor parameter, typed against the interface (not the concrete class).
Barrel index.ts files must re-export the model interface, repository interface + class, and service interface + class, matching the exact export structure of existing modules.
AuditRecord's action field must use the AuditAction enum from `shared/types/audit-action.enum` (values: CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, APPROVE, REJECT).
Notification's type field must use the NotificationType enum from `shared/types/notification-type.enum` (values: LEAVE_SUBMITTED, LEAVE_APPROVED, LEAVE_REJECTED, LEAVE_CANCELLED, BALANCE_UPDATED).

integrationPoints.why: Audit module imports AuditAction enum; Notification module imports NotificationType enum.
